## Summary

Declare Event Record

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Event Record {:0}((IS_PROPERTY_OF));

Event Record ((NARROWER_THAN)) Continuant;

# instances
Event Record//$event_record {:1}((IS_CONTAINED_BY)) Journal//$journal;

Event Record//$record {:1}((RECORDS)) Event//$event
```

### Prose Claim


An Event Record is immutable.


## Semantics

An Event Record is a persistent description of an event and its recorded evidence.

## Summary

Define EXECUTES Relation

## Claim

### Formal Claim

```CFEL
# model
Relation//EXECUTES ((HAS_INVERSE)) Relation//IS_EXECUTED_BY;

Relation//EXECUTES ((HAS_CLASSIFICATION)) Derivation == Direct;

# instances
Runtime//$runtime((EXECUTES)) Execution//$execution
```

## Semantics

EXECUTES is the stored Relation from a Runtime to an Execution. Its declared inverse IS_EXECUTED_BY is a derived view. A Workflow Run remains an Execution.
